tools.name: list_project_dependencies
tools.description: Lists direct deps + framework context across ALL manifests under cwd. Polyglot monorepos return `manifests[]`; top-level fields project the cwd-nearest manifest. Flags: includeDev=true; includeOptional=false.

includeOptional.description: v2.8: include npm optionalDependencies (kind:"optional"). Default true.

offset.description: v2.5: pagination offset; default 0. Pagination caps response size only — first page is NOT faster than no-pagination (full list always resolved server-side).

limit.description: v2.5: max deps to return; default unlimited. Pair with `total` and `offset` to walk pages.

tools.name: resolve_repo
tools.description: Resolve a vague library name to a canonical github.com/owner/repo. Skip when caller already has owner/repo. Use before get_page or find_chunks.

query.description: Library name (e.g. "react") or full module path (e.g. "github.com/spf13/cobra").

ecosystem.description: Ecosystem hint; npm assumed when omitted.

tools.name: get_page
tools.description: Fetch a CodeWiki page by slug; set listPages:true for the page index; set prepareOnly:true to pre-warm the index without returning page content (side effect: HTTP fetch + sqlite write, subject to CodeWiki rate-limit 1 page/4s per origin). Always surface citation.sourceUrl.

slug.description: Top-level page slug within the repo wiki. Omit to fetch the root/overview page.

subsection.description: Deeper heading slug — when given, returns only that subsection subtree.

listPages.description: When true, returns the page index (table of contents) for this repo instead of fetching a page. Other args ignored.

prepareOnly.description: When true, pre-warms the index for `repo` (HTTP fetch + sqlite write). Sync race against INDEX_BUILD_TIMEOUT_MS; returns status:ready or status:index_building. Idempotent via single-flight + TTL — safe to retry. Use only when find_chunks reported status:index_building and you need a guaranteed cache hit.

tools.name: find_chunks
tools.description: Hybrid semantic+BM25 retrieval over CodeWiki pages. Returns ranked chunks with anchored citations. Pass `repo` to scope; omit to query already-indexed repos. find_chunks auto-indexes the repo on first call — do NOT pre-warm unless a prior call returned status:index_building. Always surface citation.sourceUrl.

query.description: Natural-language query to retrieve relevant chunks for.

repo.description: Canonical "<owner>/<repo>" to scope retrieval. Omit to query already-indexed repos.

offset.description: v2.5: pagination offset; default 0. Pair with `total` in the response to walk pages.

tools.name: find_neighbors
tools.description: Traverse the CodeWiki knowledge graph: find pages referencing a file, diagram-node neighbors, intra-repo section links, or cross-repo references. Pass a query.kind plus its required fields. Always surface citation.sourceUrl.

kind.description:
Query kind — each value requires its own co-fields:
- pages_referencing_file: requires file_path
- diagram_neighbors: requires repo + section_slug
- section_links: requires repo + section_slug
- cross_repo: requires repo
All other input fields (github_repo, diagram_node_id, direction, limit, query) are optional regardless of kind.

file_path.description: Required when kind=pages_referencing_file. Repo-relative file path whose referencing sections are returned.

repo.description: Required when kind ∈ {diagram_neighbors, section_links, cross_repo}. Canonical "<owner>/<repo>" of the wiki to traverse.

section_slug.description: Required when kind ∈ {diagram_neighbors, section_links}. Heading slug anchoring the traversal.

diagram_node_id.description: Optional when kind=diagram_neighbors. Stable Graphviz node id (the SVG <title> / Mermaid alias, e.g. "ReactHooks.js"), NOT the human-readable label. Discover ids from get_page diagram text-fallback ("nodes: <id>=\"<label>\"") or the Mermaid block. Omit to return all diagram members of the section.
